key_decisions.decision: Keeps the exclusive contents statement without harmonizing other passages.
Preserves the darkness image in the opening declaration.
Keeps the emphatic claim and poetic parallel.
Preserves the question challenging the building’s capacity.
Makes the judicial oath’s curse explicit.
Preserves both individual and collective petition, and the affliction of each heart; focused reread restored the explicit collective scope.
Preserves the expansive foreigner petition without adding conditions.
Preserves universal sin, divine anger and captivity without shortening.
Retains rebellion and repeated compassion, not an invented immediate release.
Keeps all duration expressions and geographic limits.
Retains the eighth-day wording and tents image without smoothing the chronology.
